title: Auto Torch Placer
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Place light automatically.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex YouTube channel.
It automatically places torches or other available light sources when needed, helping keep areas well-lit without manual placement. Also there is a custom command which help you to customaize settings. Checkout "autotorch" command!.
